steps.n1: يضاف السكر إلى اللبن بعد تسخينه ويخلط جيدا حتى يذوب السكر.

en.title: Chocolate Buttercream

steps.n1: Add the sugar to the warmed milk and mix well until the sugar is completely dissolved.
steps.n2: Cream the butter with the cocoa powder, then add it to the milk mixture and whisk well until the consistency thickens.

legacySteps: Add the sugar to the warmed milk and mix well until the sugar is completely dissolved.
